verses.text: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; For His lovingkindness is everlasting.
verses.textZh: 你們要稱謝耶和華，因他本為善；他的慈愛永遠長存！

verses.text: Oh let Israel say, 'His lovingkindness is everlasting.'
verses.textZh: 願以色列說：他的慈愛永遠長存！

verses.text: Oh let the house of Aaron say, 'His lovingkindness is everlasting.'
verses.textZh: 願亞倫的家說：他的慈愛永遠長存！

verses.text: Oh let those who fear the LORD say, 'His lovingkindness is everlasting.'
verses.textZh: 願敬畏耶和華的說：他的慈愛永遠長存！

verses.text: From [my] distress I called upon the LORD; The LORD answered me [and] [set me] in a large place.
verses.textZh: 我在急難中求告耶和華，他就應允我，把我安置在寬闊之地。

verses.text: The LORD is for me; I will not fear; What can man do to me?
verses.textZh: 有耶和華幫助我，我必不懼怕，人能把我怎麼樣呢？

verses.text: The LORD is for me among those who help me; Therefore I will look [with satisfaction] on those who hate me.
verses.textZh: 在那幫助我的人中，有耶和華幫助我，所以我要看見那恨我的人遭報。

verses.text: It is better to take refuge in the LORD Than to trust in man.
verses.textZh: 投靠耶和華，強似倚賴人；

verses.text: It is better to take refuge in the LORD Than to trust in princes.
verses.textZh: 投靠耶和華，強似倚賴王子。

verses.text: All nations surrounded me; In the name of the LORD I will surely cut them off.
verses.textZh: 萬民圍繞我，我靠耶和華的名必剿滅他們。

verses.text: They surrounded me, yes, they surrounded me; In the name of the LORD I will surely cut them off.
verses.textZh: 他們環繞我，圍困我，我靠耶和華的名必剿滅他們。

verses.text: They surrounded me like bees; They were extinguished as a fire of thorns; In the name of the LORD I will surely cut them off.
verses.textZh: 他們如同蜂子圍繞我，好像燒荊棘的火，必被熄滅；我靠耶和華的名，必剿滅他們。

verses.text: You pushed me violently so that I was falling, But the LORD helped me.
verses.textZh: 你推我，要叫我跌倒，但耶和華幫助了我。

verses.text: The LORD is my strength and song, And He has become my salvation.
verses.textZh: 耶和華是我的力量，是我的詩歌；他也成了我的拯救。

verses.text: The sound of joyful shouting and salvation is in the tents of the righteous; The right hand of the LORD does valiantly.
verses.textZh: 在義人的帳棚裡，有歡呼拯救的聲音；耶和華的右手施展大能。

verses.text: The right hand of the LORD is exalted; The right hand of the LORD does valiantly.
verses.textZh: 耶和華的右手高舉；耶和華的右手施展大能。

verses.text: I will not die, but live, And tell of the works of the LORD.
verses.textZh: 我必不致死，仍要存活，並要傳揚耶和華的作為。

verses.text: The LORD has disciplined me severely, But He has not given me over to death.
verses.textZh: 耶和華雖嚴嚴地懲治我，卻未曾將我交於死亡。

verses.text: Open to me the gates of righteousness; I shall enter through them, I shall give thanks to the LORD.
verses.textZh: 給我敞開義門；我要進去稱謝耶和華！

verses.text: This is the gate of the LORD; The righteous will enter through it.
verses.textZh: 這是耶和華的門；義人要進去！

verses.text: I shall give thanks to You, for You have answered me, And You have become my salvation.
verses.textZh: 我要稱謝你，因為你已經應允我，又成了我的拯救！

verses.text: The stone which the builders rejected Has become the chief corner [stone].
verses.textZh: 匠人所棄的石頭已成了房角的頭塊石頭。

verses.text: This is the LORD'S doing; It is marvelous in our eyes.
verses.textZh: 這是耶和華所做的，在我們眼中看為希奇。

verses.text: This is the day which the LORD has made; Let us rejoice and be glad in it.
verses.textZh: 這是耶和華所定的日子，我們在其中要高興歡喜！

verses.text: O LORD, do save, we beseech You; O LORD, we beseech You, do send prosperity!
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，求你拯救！耶和華啊，求你使我們亨通！

verses.text: Blessed is the one who comes in the name of the LORD; We have blessed you from the house of the LORD.
verses.textZh: 奉耶和華名來的是應當稱頌的！我們從耶和華的殿中為你們祝福！

verses.text: The LORD is God, and He has given us light; Bind the festival sacrifice with cords to the horns of the altar.
verses.textZh: 耶和華是神；他光照了我們。理當用繩索把祭牲拴住，牽到壇角那裡。

verses.text: You are my God, and I give thanks to You; [You are] my God, I extol You.
verses.textZh: 你是我的神，我要稱謝你！你是我的神，我要尊崇你！

verses.text: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; For His lovingkindness is everlasting.
verses.textZh: 你們要稱謝耶和華，因他本為善；他的慈愛永遠長存！
